content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis lacks estimand attributes (population, variable, summary measure)",
      "quote": "The primary estimand of interest, the intercurrent event(s) strategy, and missing data handling methods for the primary endpoint (binary response) are described in Table 2.",
      "page": 86,
      "section": "11.4.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text refers to a table for the estimand but does not explicitly state the population, variable, and summary measure attributes in the narrative. The table is not fully reproduced in the extracted text, so the estimand attributes are incomplete.",
      "fix": "Explicitly define the estimand attributes (population, variable, intercurrent events, summary measure) in the text, not only in a table."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints lack stated analysis methods",
      "quote": "Secondary Endpoints for Efficacy: • Proportion of patients with improvement (reduction) of weekly average of daily hand and foot peak Pruritus NRS ≥3 from baseline to week 16",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not describe analysis methods for the secondary efficacy endpoints (e.g., proportion endpoints, percent change endpoints). Only the primary endpoint analysis is detailed.",
      "fix": "Add a section describing the statistical methods for each secondary endpoint, including model, covariates, and handling of intercurrent events."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing data handling for secondary endpoints not specified",
      "quote": "Handling of missing data due to the COVID-19 pandemic and any additional analyses required to investigate the impact of COVID-19 to understand estimated treatment effect and safety will be detailed in the SAP.",
      "page": 84,
      "section": "11",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text only mentions missing data handling for COVID-19, but does not specify general missing data methods for secondary endpoints. This is a gap in the statistical plan.",
      "fix": "Specify missing data handling strategies for all secondary endpoints, not just for COVID-19-related missingness."
    },
    {
      "title": "Multiplicity control not described",
      "quote": "For comparison of dupilumab treatment to placebo, the following hypothesis of the primary endpoint will be tested:",
      "page": 84,
      "section": "11.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not mention any method to control the family-wise error rate for multiple secondary endpoints or for the primary and key secondary endpoints. This is a critical gap.",
      "fix": "Add a section on multiplicity control, e.g., hierarchical testing or Bonferroni adjustment, for the primary and secondary endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size section not provided in extracted text",
      "quote": "This section provides the basis for the SAP for the study.",
      "page": 84,
      "section": "11",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The extracted text does not include a sample size section. The protocol should have a section with sample size assumptions (e.g., event rates, effect size, alpha, power) to justify the number of patients.",
      "fix": "Include a sample size section with all inputs and assumptions, and ensure consistency with the primary endpoint analysis."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoints lack analysis methods",
      "quote": "Exploratory Endpoints [p41] • In patients with AD lesions on other parts of the body in addition to hands and feet; − Percent change in EASI score from baseline to week 16",
      "page": 41,
      "section": "4.1.4",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not describe how exploratory endpoints will be analyzed. While exploratory analyses may be less formal, a brief description is expected.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection for exploratory endpoint analyses, even if descriptive only."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistency in primary endpoint definition between objectives and endpoints",
      "quote": "Proportion of patients achieving an IGA (hand and foot) score of 0 or 1 at week 16",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The primary objective mentions 'skin lesions' but the endpoint specifies 'IGA (hand and foot) score of 0 or 1'. This is consistent, but the objective is vague; however, the endpoint is clear. No major inconsistency found, but the objective could be more specific.",
      "fix": "Align the primary objective wording with the endpoint definition for clarity."
    },
    {
      "title": "Safety endpoint analysis not described",
      "quote": "Secondary Endpoint for Safety: • Incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) through week 16",
      "page": 40,
      "section": "4.1.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical plan does not describe the analysis for the safety endpoint (TEAEs). It only mentions that safety variables will be analyzed using SAF, but no statistical methods are given.",
      "fix": "Add a section on safety analyses, including how TEAEs will be summarized and compared between treatment groups."
    }
  ]
}
